description: Read a CarlNotes Specials page: Topic Specials across a person's topics, Podcast Specials across a person's podcasts, or Team Specials across a team's topics. It returns the summary of views or plays, Carl's paragraph about the month, the last day the snapshot counts, and the page's url. A team's Specials show only the summary to someone not on the team. Leave out userId or teamId for the connected account's own Specials or its first team. Use it when the user asks Carl for their Specials, how are my topics doing, how is my podcast doing, or how is my team doing.

dashboardKind.description: Which Specials: topics or podcasts for a person, or team for a team.

selection.description: What the charts count, which the MCP view asks for. Leave it out.

teamId.description: The team whose Team Specials to read.

userId.description: The person whose Topic or Podcast Specials to read.
